newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 tax collection seen up 17 percent.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 tax collection seen up 17 percent.

text.p: China is expected to collect 630 billion yuan ($75.9 billion) in industrial and commercial taxes in 1996, up 17 percent from 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
It would be the fourth consecutive year in which China's tax collection increased by more than 90 billion yuan compared with the previous year, Xinhua said.
In the first 11 months of 1996, China collected 563.9 billion yuan in taxes, up 91.9 billion yuan compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Value-added and consumer taxes collected surged 43 billion yuan to 318 billion yuan, while agricultural taxes totalled 29.7 billion yuan.
